title: The Boy at Christ's Christmas Tree
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
source_note: Text from ru.wikisource.org, after F. M. Dostoevsky, Diary of a Writer, 1876.

names.I: The Boy with His Hand Out

art_alt.1_hand_out: A street corner on a frosty evening, a small boy in a thin smock holding out his hand to passers-by under a lamp
art_alt.2_cellar: A dark cellar with a small high window, a bunk with a still shape, a small boy on a chest breathing white steam, an old woman in a corner
art_alt.3_shop_windows: Lit shop windows at night, one with a Christmas tree and children, one with three little fiddling dolls, a small boy at the glass in the snow
art_alt.4_christs_tree: A great tree of golden lights in a deep blue sky, bright children flying round it, mothers standing to one side
art_alt.5_yard: A snowy back yard at dawn, a woodpile by a gateway, a small shape in the snow and a yard-keeper with a broom coming

street slang of the time for begging, which the boys themselves invented.
a servant who looked after a building's yard and gate, swept the snow and watched the entrance.
an institution for abandoned babies, which sent them out to be nursed by peasant women for pay.
the hunger of 1873-74 in the Samara region on the Volga, in which many people died.
the Christmas tree of the heavenly children; in Russia a decorated tree was the great festival of childhood.
summary: On the eve of Christmas, a little boy who has lost his mother in a freezing city looks through shop windows at trees and dolls he cannot touch. Dostoevsky's short Christmas story, a few pages that never leave the reader.
site_description: On the eve of Christmas, in an enormous freezing city, a small boy wakes in a cellar beside his mother, who will not wake. He goes out to look for bread and finds only lit windows, a tree he cannot reach and dolls that seem alive. Dostoevsky's brief Christmas story, written for his Diary of a Writer in 1876, is about the children nobody counts and the tree that waits for them.

ru.title: Мальчик у Христа на ёлке
ru.author: Фёдор Достоевский
ru.note: Рассказ в издании для чтения с оригинальными иллюстрациями.

ru.description: В канун Рождества в огромном замёрзшем городе маленький мальчик просыпается в подвале рядом с матерью, которая не просыпается. Он выходит искать хлеба и видит только освещённые окна, недоступную ёлку и кукол, как живых. Короткий рождественский рассказ Достоевского из «Дневника писателя» 1876 года о детях, которых никто не считает, и о ёлке, которая их ждёт.
